title: (No AI) Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
author: Emma Roth
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/project-suncatcher-google.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Google's AI chip-equipped satellite has generated its first response from space. In a blog post on Friday, [Google says](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-research/project-suncatcher-satellite-response/) it successfully booted up the satellite's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), allowing the on-board Gemma 4 model to follow through on a prompt to create a haiku about being in space:

> Blue marble below
> 
> Data streams in silent grace
> 
> Starlight feeds my core. ✨

Google says it tried out other space-themed limericks and telemetry prompts as well. The test is part of Google's Project Suncatcher, [an experimental initiative](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1000015/google-ai-satellite-space-project-suncatcher) that could eventually put AI data centers in space. Google launched the satellite into orbit [earlier this …](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1003838/googles-ai-satellite-successfully-launches-into-space)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1023528/google-project-suncatcher-ai-satellite-transmission)

title: (No AI) Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a ‘personalized digital menu’ at the drive-thru
author: Emma Roth
content:
![A photo of a Starbucks drive-thru](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/gettyimages-2268681559.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Starbucks could eventually show you a personalized digital menu when you pull up to the drive-thru. During [an earnings call on Thursday](https://s203.q4cdn.com/326826266/files/content_files/Q4-FY26-SBUX-Transcript.pdf), Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol said the company is going to explore "experiences that recognize participating customers as they arrive, present personalized digital menus, and make payment more effortless," as spotted earlier by [_More Perfect Union_](https://bsky.app/profile/moreperfectunion.bsky.social/post/3mz42442ai22z).

It sounds similar to the technology that [Taco Bell is experimenting with](https://www.businessinsider.com/taco-bell-brings-more-ai-drive-thrus-yum-brands-expansion-2026-4), which could change the layout, content, and visuals on a digital menu board "on a car-by-car basis." McDonald's also r[ecently showed off an AI-powered feature](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/947644/mcdonalds-latest-ai-drive-thru-test-will-let-customers-ask-can-i-get-my-usual) it's piloting at a handful of dri …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1023440/starbucks-ai-personalized-menu-drive-thru)
